profile.headline: Senior Embedded Software Engineer at Cruise

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Firmware Lead for the MCU responsible for power and diagnostic monitoring of the telematics 
and network gateway system for the next gen Cruise AV.  Coordinated debug with, and release 
to, the manufacturer.  Collaborated with the hardware team to define and implement the power 
on/off sequence and dependencies.  Designed a configurable power sequencer interface, 
contributed to HAL and driver bring-up, and implemented monitoring (I2C, GPIO, ADC), and 
UART/CLI tasks.  Led weekly sync meetings to coordinate debug, design, and milestone/release 
definitions. 
• Firmware Lead for the design of a common software update solution for a family of 5+ projects 
using the same family of MCU (C++, python, CAN, ethernet).  Designed a protocol-agnostic 
solution, and implemented the host portion (backend to device). 
• Firmware Lead for the MCU responsible for powering, monitoring, and cooling the Cruise 
Origin AV compute system.  Led weekly sync meetings with the firmware vendor, and with 
Cruise internal systems engineering/developer/test teams.  Coordinated vendor deliverables and 
debug sessions, and integrated their releases with diagnostic monitoring (C++) and software 
update (python) code.  Designed, implemented, and was awarded a patent for a custom software 
update solution. 
• Culture buddy/mentor for new Cruise employees

positions.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
• Firmware Lead for Era Pro vaporizer:  Responsible for heater and UI (including some design) modules, and 50% battery life increase post-launch.  Lead weekly meeting with CE team for BLE communication design.  Point of contact with Beta, CS, EE, Data Science, QA, and pod filling teams. Lead the project from DVT through MP and two production OTA updates.
• Firmware Lead for Era Life vaporizer:  Led the project from beta (EVT) through launch.  Responsible for heater and pressure sensor algorithms.
• Next generation product support:  Responsible for firmware prototypes and feasibilities for new heater topologies, including risk assessment and identifying success metrics.
• Co-op mentor

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
• Advanced Technology Team: rapid prototype and design for “smart” lab.  Technical feasibility.  Chose processor, peripherals, and communications protocols.  Board bring-up.  
• Wrote firmware for second generation temperature/humidity/pressure/light monitor.  
• Designed and wrote manufacturing software for Automated Test Equipment, and for automated  calibration verification and adjustment.  Transferred to/trained new contract manufacturer.  
• Took over ownership of temperature sensor firmware.  Stabilized embedded platform and  improved battery life by 300%.  Assisted in Android gateway app development and stability.   
• Designed third generation sensor, a configurable serial communication platform to connect to  existing lab equipment.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer II
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, tested, and documented firmware for Class II /III blood glucose meters,  according to ISO, FDA, and TUV standards.  
• Wrote blood glucose test engine and FLASH storage.  Supported software tool for data  retrieval and analysis.  Worked closely with electrochemists to refine blood glucose algorithm.  
• Wrote automated unit test suite for BLE module, facilitating integration with smartphone app.  
• Implemented and unit tested insulin dosing algorithm and user interface.  
• Wrote drivers for timers, piezo, accelerometer, RTC, ADC, DMA, and LCD.
